front: Wednesday's ten-game slate was mostly close; the one rout was Brooklyn by 34 over New Orleans, which sank Dejounte Murray (5 points) and Fears. Curry left after 6 minutes, Paul George and Ajay Mitchell sat, and the night belonged to secondary pieces: Dylan Harper (55 with 10 assists and 5 stocks), Avdija (6 stocks), Hartenstein and Zubac in bigger roles, while Luka (46), Gilgeous-Alexander (40, 0-7 from three) and Giddey (7 turnovers) came in well under. Your 80 teams had a median finish in the top 46%; 9 made the top 10%, none the top 1% (best top 2.6%), and 15 cashed, returning $150 on $400. One season verdict settled: your morning board now beats ADP, picking the right player on 55% of 1,601 close calls, though last night it was right on only 44% of its disagreements with our projection. The blowout pattern held again (fades on Murray, Fears and Carter were right, now 18 right and 3 wrong on the season), and the afternoon raises on players back from injury lost: Quickley went 3-14 and McCain 3-14 with Ajay out. Nothing to decide today.
